findings.description: Classic N+1 query pattern. The previous implementation fetched all orders in one findMany with `id: { in: orderIds }`, one round trip. The new loop issues one findUnique per id — for 100 orders that is 100 sequential DB round trips instead of 1. Latency scales linearly with input. Restore the batched findMany; if per-order transforms are needed, apply them in memory after the batch fetch.
